in_marathi.name: Dattika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dattika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dattika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Datta’, which means ‘giver’. The name signifies the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and abundance. In Hindu mythology, Dattika is considered the sister of Dattatreya, a popular deity worshipped for his three aspects: Purusha, Rishi, and Avyaya.
